development_evidence.population: opened ORN v3+v4+v5+v6 after ORN v7 freeze

version_rationale.earlier_version: ORN v6 used mel min_confidence 0.75 with default decode and no Basic Pitch gap fill. Pure Basic Pitch plus identity on the same opened pool later peaked near F1 0.751.
version_rationale.earlier_limitation: On sealed v6 the mel-only candidate under-predicted (6338 vs 6599) and lockbox F1 was 0.777074. On opened v3-v6 together, mel-only F1 is 0.795928 with recall 0.780158.
version_rationale.later_change: After sealing v7, keep mel notes at confidence 0.75 and add sanitized Basic Pitch notes whose overlap with any mel note is at most 0.02 seconds.
version_rationale.comparable_result: On 494 opened rows the gap fill reaches F1 0.818999 with precision 0.815930 and recall 0.822090, versus mel-only F1 0.795928 on the same rows.
version_rationale.status: frozen for one-shot ORN v7 evaluation; no ORN v7 target or key has been read
